```{r score tanner boy}
# Code script to score the Tanner Scale (Male)  - Marshall & Tanner (1970)
# https://adc.bmj.com/content/45/239/13
# Scoring instructions: Sum individual item responses to get the raw total score. Note that for each individual question, 4 refers to the highest developmental stage, while a response of 5 indicates "I don't know."


# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
tanner_boy <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/tanner_boy.tsv")

# Compute total scores for each individual participant
tanner_boy <- tanner_boy %>%
  mutate(
  tanner_boy_total_score = if_else(
    if_all(tanner_boy_1:tanner_boy_6, is.na),
    NA_real_,
    rowSums(across(tanner_boy_1:tanner_boy_6), na.rm = TRUE) # if all the values are NA, then final score is NA
  )
)
write_tsv(tanner_boy,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/tanner_boy.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r tanner boy distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

tanner_boy %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tanner_boy_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "Tanner (Male) total score (sum items 1–6)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of Tanner (Male) total scores")

```
